name: PHP
note: Server-side scripting language for the web
typeSystem: Dynamic, with optional runtime-enforced declarations for parameters, returns, properties, and other constructs. Scalar calls are coercive by default; strict_types enables strict checking for most scalar parameter and return declarations.

typeSystemExample.caption: Generic max: no generics, uses union type hints (PHP 8+)
typeSystemExample.source:
<?php
function max_of(int|float $a, int|float $b): int|float {
    return $a >= $b ? $a : $b;
}

echo max_of(3, 7) . "\n";
echo max_of(1.5, 2.8) . "\n";

runtime: Compiled to Zend opcodes and executed by the Zend Engine, commonly in a per-request server model

runtimes.name: Zend Engine
runtimes.role: Reference engine; compiles to opcodes executed per request.

runtimes.name: OPcache + JIT (PHP 8+)
runtimes.role: Caches opcodes and JIT-compiles hot paths.

concurrencyModel: Synchronous per request; Fibers (8.1+) and async extensions

concurrencyExample.caption: 4 workers computing i*i via Fibers (PHP 8.1+)
concurrencyExample.source:
<?php
$fibers = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < 4; $i++) {
    $n = $i;
    $fibers[] = new Fiber(function () use ($n) {
        Fiber::suspend($n * $n);
    });
}

foreach ($fibers as $f) {
    echo $f->start() . ' ';
}
